claims._source: One-line statements written from the artifact plan gen_plan_research_1_idx7 (title, summary, question, explanation, Step 5.2 'what this run adds' design facts). The iteration-6 hypothesis text itself was not passed to this executor, so the wording is the plan's, not the hypothesis's.
claims.L1a: Landing identity: a content-free nudge (random activation perturbation) or a ban moves the tuned model (Qwen3-8B) off its default algorithm onto the BASE model's runner-up algorithm, forecast in advance (sha256-committed) from the base model's composition and checked by tests/algorithm labels.
claims.L1b: Rival-aware landing: the base-runner-up forecast is scored against rivals built from the tuned model itself (its teacher-forced likelihood ranking q_lik and its own sampled tail q_tail), including tail-empty events (twin N 300).
claims.L2: Support: the perturbed tuned model's algorithm distribution stays inside the base model's support.
claims.L3: Shape: the perturbed/tuned distribution is fit by the base distribution raised to a power (p^alpha sharpening) better than parametric rivals or the tuned tail.
claims.E: Engine control: the iteration-4 plan-site sensitivity of Qwen3-8B may be a property of its FP8 W8A8 serving engine; a 2x2 weight-by-activation precision factorial (W8A8, W8A16, W16A8, W16A16) with identical hook code, per-position doses and CRN slots decides it.
claims.E-attribution: Attribution of any precision effect to activation vs weight quantisation, with per-token absmax and FP8-scale readouts as the mechanism readout.
claims.E-deployment: Deployment finding (if positive): activation quantisation changes how far a model can be nudged (nudgeability) while its default output and accuracy are unchanged.
claims.S-a: Site: content-free perturbation of prefill task-specification states, by block band, changes the categorical algorithm choice (bf16).
claims.S-b: Site: the read position (last prompt token) compared with task-spec positions at matched per-position dose.
claims.S-c: Site: condition/instruction tokens vs generated tokens as perturbation sites at matched dose.
claims.S-d: Site comparison method: matched per-position dose or downstream-displacement match with paired CRN flips.
claims.F1: Forks: the position of first divergence (an 'entrance' fork) is where algorithm choice is decided.
claims.F2: Margins: the twin's teacher-forced log-odds margin between algorithm openings bounds (explains) the temperature effect; a large logit margin makes temperature inert.
claims.K: Knobs: algorithm-level, test-checked prices (H5/P15/P20, full-simplex hull) of base intent, base/instruct weight interpolation (lambda 0.25/0.5), enumerate-and-pick, proxy tuning/EFT and bf16 plan noise.
claims.G: Generality/scope: cross-reference to Table 92c row C3c (scope against FunSearch/AlphaEvolve); no new search.

rubric.scale: each axis 1 / 0.5 / 0; total >= 2.5 occupies; 1-2 adjacent; < 1 irrelevant

L1.O: identity of where a perturbed/steered/prompt-banned/fine-tune-perturbed tuned model lands, checked by exact token, answer key, execution or mechanism label (0.5 if judged by an LLM or embedding)
L1.I: the base model's ranking or composition of alternatives used as the forecast
L1.C: a rival built from the tuned model itself (sampled tail, likelihood ranking, pre-perturbation distribution) OR a forecast committed before the outcome (1 if both, 0.5 if one)

L2_L3.O: support or shape of the perturbed/tuned distribution
L2_L3.I: base support or base distribution raised to a power
L2_L3.C: compared with other parametric rivals or with the tuned tail

E.O: behavioural effect of an activation-level intervention (rate, size, direction)
E.I: activation precision varied at matched weights (1); weight-only precision (0.5); numerics/batch only (0, scored 0.5 on C)
E.C: same intervention, same inputs, across precisions (1); different vectors per precision (0.5)

E_deployment.O: whether nudgeability/steerability differs while the default/accuracy is unchanged

S.O: categorical solution or strategy choice (1), continuous attribute (0.5)
S.I: content-free (random/isotropic) perturbation at declared sites and layer bands
S.C: matched per-position dose or downstream-displacement match across sites

F.O: position of first divergence or a fork's outcome shift
F.C: temperature sweep explained by the margin

K.I: base-aligned collaboration, base/instruct weight interpolation, proxy tuning/EFT
K.C: priced against other knobs at matched correctness

flags.FLAG_E: FIRES if a paper reports that ACTIVATION quantisation (FP8 or INT8 activations, any scale granularity; W8A8, W4A8, FP8 activations with per-token or per-tensor scales; FP8 KV-cache counts as activation-side) changes the behavioural effect, success rate or direction of an activation-level intervention (steering/activation addition, noise injection, patching, ablation, SAE-latent editing) relative to higher-precision activations on the same or matched weights. PARTLY FIRED if the varied factor is weight-only (INT8/NF4/INT4/GPTQ/AWQ), or the outcome is internal only (vector cosine, probe accuracy), or numerics change intervention outcomes only via batch/kernel nondeterminism. ADJACENT if numerics or quantisation change outputs with no intervention (nondeterminism, FP8 outlier sensitivity, flips).
flags.FLAG_L: FIRES if a paper (i) perturbs, steers, prompts against or fine-tunes a tuned model away from its default output, (ii) forecasts from the base model where it lands (identity or distribution, any granularity), and (iii) scores that forecast against a rival built from the tuned model itself (its own sampled tail, its own likelihood ranking of alternatives, or its pre-perturbation distribution). PARTLY FIRED if (i)+(ii) without (iii); or (ii)+(iii) retrospective rather than forecast; or token-level only with (i)-(iii). ADJACENT: candidate preservation under post-training without a perturbation (URIAL, Same Candidates, Sparse but Critical, crystallization), stylised accounts (power sharpening).
flags.FLAG_S_secondary: fires if a paper compares sites (prompt/prefill positions by layer band vs last token vs condition tokens vs generated tokens) for content-free perturbations at matched dose and reports which site changes a categorical solution choice
flags.FLAG_K_secondary: fires if a paper reports test-checked, algorithm- or strategy-level code diversity under base/aligned weight interpolation, base-aligned collaboration or proxy tuning

consequences.FLAG_E_FIRES: Claim E's deployment finding is written as a replication; only what the neighbour lacks may be claimed
consequences.FLAG_E_NOT_FIRED: dated 'to our knowledge' wording; weight-only evidence named as the closest neighbour
consequences.FLAG_L_FIRES: L1 framed as a replication at the algorithm level; only prospective commitment, tail-empty events and test-checked labels claimed
consequences.FLAG_L_NOT_FIRED: the 92d A2 sentence is updated with the new neighbours and the tail/likelihood rivals
consequences.first: the word 'first' is never licensed by a search

stop_rule: After all families and one forward-citation round, build up to 6 round-2 queries from the vocabulary of included hits; then round 3 = forward citations of the closest new hits plus backward references (BC) of the two closest hits per flag. Stop when a round adds no new hit scoring >= 1.5 on any claim, or at the Stage-2 cap (60 min wall time). Report which condition stopped the search.

quote_rules.verified: verbatim match in the paper's own versioned text (arXiv HTML vN or PDF vN, ACL Anthology, PMLR, NeurIPS, OpenReview page) after whitespace/ligature/quote/dash/hyphenation normalisation
quote_rules.verified_abstract: match only in an abstract record (arXiv abs page / API / OpenReview note); no numbers beyond the abstract
quote_rules.verified_blog: match in the text of a grey-literature post (LessWrong / Alignment Forum / transformer-circuits.pub)
quote_rules.unverified: no match or not fetchable; carries no number
quote_rules.version: quote the latest version; record v1 date and any version where the quoted number or title differs
